findings.title: Default-strategy upgrade tests never enable rolling-updates
findings.body: createInitialDeployment returns immediately when the update strategy is null, before spec.features.enabled is set to rolling-updates. The parameterized tests include that null strategy, which is the documented default, and still expect a successful rolling upgrade (cache max-count) or recreate upgrade (image change). The new operator guide says this preview feature must be enabled or the operator fails. Those default-strategy deployments therefore run without the feature this change requires, so reconciliation fails or the tests no longer cover the configuration operators must use. Enable rolling-updates on every deployment this helper returns, including the null strategy.

findings.title: Exit code 4 is documented as a compatibility result
findings.body: The check-command exit-code table says exit code 4 means "Rolling Upgrade is not possible" because rolling-updates is disabled. The implementation exits 4 before reading metadata or comparing versions, and prints that the command cannot be used. That is not a compatibility decision: a rolling upgrade may still be possible. The guide tells automation to branch only on these exit codes, and exit code 3 is the code that means shut the deployment down and recreate. Describing 4 the same way ("Rolling Upgrade is not possible") leads scripts to treat a missing feature flag as a required outage, or to treat an inconclusive run as a finished negative check. Document 4 as "command did not run; feature not enabled; result inconclusive", and note that the metadata subcommand uses the same code.

findings.title: Changed CLI exit codes are not asserted
findings.body: testFeatureNotEnabled only checks the stderr text for the metadata subcommand and never asserts exit code 4. The same gate in the check subcommand is not tested. testWrongVersions still only checks log text, so nothing locks the recreate result after this PR changes RECREATE_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE from 4 to 3 and reuses 4 for feature disabled. Automation is supposed to choose rolling versus shutdown from these codes; swapping them would not fail CI.
